item.text:
Created a complete std-only Rust project in [Cargo.toml](/output/Cargo.toml), with the entry at [test19.rs](/output/test19.rs) and library modules under [src/lib.rs](/output/src/lib.rs) and [src/triangulator.rs](/output/src/triangulator.rs). The binary accepts the same optional positional `n` argument via `std::env::args()`, reproduces the C++ `atoi` behavior closely, builds the same polygon, and prints indices with the same trailing-space/no-newline format as `std::cout`.

I implemented an earcut-style triangulator from scratch using only `std`, including linked-list ear clipping, local self-intersection curing, polygon splitting, and the hashed path for larger inputs. It compiles with both `cargo build --release` and `rustc --edition=2021 test19.rs -O -o /output/test19`. I verified the Rust output against `/workspace/dataset/test19_executable` for `n=0..80`; all checked cases matched exactly.
